research_question: Can latency be reduced safely by using MiniLM only to reject very low-similarity operation batches while delegating every surviving batch to the already-validated beta=1 BGE scorer?
candidate_family: MiniLM fast-reject only; no fast accept; beta=1 sibling-contrastive BGE for all survivors

selection.objective: lowest paired mean CPU latency among candidates meeting both floors
selection.baseline: frozen full beta=1 sibling-contrastive BGE measured in the same sequential job as each candidate or in a single paired sweep job

confirmation.rule: freeze the selected dev winner, then run it unchanged once against a same-job full-BGE baseline; both quality floors and lower mean latency are required

guardrails: Do not use v12, v13, v14, or v15 for threshold, model, representation, or architecture selection.
Do not change semantic recall, capability-fit, endpoint-disambiguation, BGE beta, pairwise min score, or pairwise min margin during this cycle.
The MiniLM prefilter has reject-only authority; it cannot fast-accept or rank an endpoint.
If no preregistered candidate meets both quality floors and reduces paired mean latency, retain the full-BGE optional profile and close the cycle without blind-final generation.
